newsitem.title: USA: Vermont lawmakers eye cutting sales tax on border.
newsitem.headline: Vermont lawmakers eye cutting sales tax on border.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 16 (Reuter) A plan by Vermont lawmakers to cut sales taxes along the New Hampshire border would create a two-tiered sales tax in Vermont.
The idea is gaining support from key lawmakers, including House Speaker Michael Obuchowski and Senate President Peter Shumlin.
The idea is to improve competition with sales tax-free New Hampshire by cutting Vermont's sale tax rate from five to three-percent for towns touching the Connecticut River.
